title: 第14章 甲胄第15章 修复板链甲
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
从帝国金行到下城酒馆一路畅通，没再遇到麻烦，到了独脚酒馆后，其他士兵也全部到场，甚至点好了饭食。
沃尔坐下后，直截了当道：
“午饭过后，我们去购买护甲，然后就开始接取任务，你们有什么想法可以提出来。”
虽然有所预料，但士兵们还是极为兴奋，甚至有些不可置信。
足量薪资，丰盛伙食，配给武器，传授技能，现在还要给买甲胄护身，在这个世界，这些事连不少亲爹妈都办不到！
不过队长已经提问，士兵们也是努力思考起来，想要提供一些有用的东西出来。
沃尔也是在这十多天的相处中才发现，自己虽然受过正规的职业者训练，读过不少书籍，但对于底层冒险者的了解，还真不如这些一直身处其中的人。
其中，一直在青木镇附近生活的阿尔文提出，在镇外，有人一直在举办私下的交易场所，传闻里面涉及到非法交易，里面就能买到新鲜的二手甲胄，价格低出市场很多。
另一个名为维尔特的兽耳亚人士兵则提议，他有一些祖传的手工艺技巧，如果沃尔购买来材料，他可以尝试制作布甲甚至是皮甲。
沃尔一一考虑，最后还是决定去那个铁翼防具店先了解一下情况再说。
虽然可以要价高些，但安全可靠更重要。
至于维尔特倒确实是个人才，有一双巧手，但家族失去了猎场，身为亚人，在青木镇没有固定居所，就找不到合适的工作，存不下钱，就租不起房。
或许以后可以培养一下。
众人一边吃饭，一边热烈讨论甲胄的事情，并且感觉这里的炖菜其实也就一般，肉和这些天的伙食比起来少得可怜，蔬菜也并不新鲜。
饭后，沃尔准备结账走人服务生却告诉他，钱已经付过。
回头看到士兵们的笑脸，沃尔也不由心头一暖，一挥手：
“走！去铁翼防具店。”
一群人等不及休息，直接一路爬坡，很快找到了位于上城区大街上的一间豪华店铺。
门口，一具炼金傀儡身穿华丽的金色翼肩板甲，每隔一段时间，它还会变换姿势，发出哗啦啦地金属碰撞声。
在那看起来就很昂贵的大门内，还隐隐能看到奇异地魔法灵光，让战士们在门口踌躇，不敢轻易踏入里面。

沃尔却不管这些，再牛逼，也只是一个商店而已，进去看几眼而已，难道还能抢走自己的钱不成。
刚进门，一个身材凹凸有致的女人便迎了上来，态度十分热烈，还将门口徘徊的士兵们都邀请进来。
“我是店长埃德琳，欢迎各位勇士到来，愿钢铁的羽翼守护你们！”
士兵们见状也挺起胸膛，但看着店内以金币为单位的价格，又缩着手纷纷远离。
沃尔拿出帝国金行半身人经理波西瓦尔的明信片，并说明来意，埃德琳依然笑靥如花，将众人带上二楼仓库，用自豪的语气说道：
“那些抵押护具形制不一，品质不定，我们铁翼商会内部拥有数位护具制作大师，会对它们进行精心养护、改造、升级……”
content_en:
The journey from the Imperial Gold Bank to the Lower City Tavern was smooth and there was no further trouble. After arriving at the One-Legged Tavern, all the other soldiers were present and even ordered meals.
After Wall sat down, he said straightforwardly:
"After lunch, we will buy armor, and then we will start accepting tasks. If you have any ideas, please put forward them."
Although they had expected it, the soldiers were still extremely excited and even a little unbelievable.
Sufficient wages, rich meals, rationing of weapons, teaching skills, and now also buying armor for protection. In this world, even many parents cannot do these things!
But the captain had already asked the question, and the soldiers were thinking hard and wanted to provide something useful.
It was only during these ten days of getting along that Wall discovered that although he had received formal professional training and had read many books, his understanding of low-level adventurers was not as good as those who had been among them.
Among them, Alvin, who has been living near Qingmu Town, pointed out that outside the town, someone has been holding a private trading place. It is rumored that illegal trading is involved, and fresh second-hand armor can be purchased there at a price much lower than the market price.
Another beast-eared demihuman soldier named Wilt suggested that he had some ancestral handicraft skills. If Wall bought the materials, he could try to make cloth armor or even leather armor.
Wall thought about it one by one, and finally decided to go to the Iron Wing armor store to understand the situation first.
Although the price may be higher, safety and reliability are more important.
As for Wilt, he is indeed a talent and has a pair of skillful hands, but his family has lost its hunting ground. As a demi-human, he has no fixed residence in Aoki Town, so he cannot find a suitable job. If he cannot save money, he cannot afford to rent a house.
Maybe it can be cultivated in the future.
While everyone was eating, they were discussing the armor issue enthusiastically, and felt that the stew here was actually just average. The meat was pitiful compared to the food these days, and the vegetables were not fresh.
After the meal, Wall was about to pay and leave, but the waiter told him that the money had already been paid.
Looking back and seeing the smiling faces of the soldiers, Wall couldn't help but feel warm in his heart and waved his hand:
"Let's go! Go to the Iron Wing Armor Shop."
A group of people couldn't wait to rest, so they climbed all the way up the hill and soon found a luxury store on the street in the uptown area.
At the door, there is an alchemy puppet wearing gorgeous golden winged shoulder plate armor. Every once in a while, it will change its posture and make a clanging sound of metal.
Inside the expensive-looking gate, a strange magical aura could be faintly seen, making the soldiers hesitate at the door, not daring to step inside easily.
Wall didn't care about this. No matter how awesome he was, it was just a store. He just went in to take a look. How could he still steal his own money?
As soon as he entered the door, a woman with a curvy figure came up to her. Her attitude was very warm and she invited all the soldiers lingering at the door to come in.
"I am the store manager Adeline. Welcome all warriors. May the wings of steel protect you!"
When the soldiers saw this, they puffed up their chests, but when they saw the price in gold coins in the store, they shrank their hands and stayed away.
Wall took out a postcard from Percival, the halfling manager of the Imperial Gold Bank, and explained his purpose of visit. Adeline, still smiling like a flower, took everyone to the warehouse on the second floor and said in a proud tone:
"Those mortgage protective gears come in different shapes and are of uncertain quality. We at the Iron Wing Chamber of Commerce have digital protective gear making masters who will carefully maintain, transform and upgrade them..."
